ar: عايز اثبت لميتا إني بعت لناس موافقة
en: Can I export a campaign report?

steps: Owner downloads a campaign report: totals, why recipients were skipped, consent-gated statement; counts only, no phone numbers
gaps: No button on the Campaigns screen yet: the report is reached by the assistant or the route
assistantNote: Counts only. The assistant reads the report back; it never lists customers.
